# Spotless Detailing

> Mobile car detailing and valeting business covering Glasgow and Greater Glasgow, Lanarkshire and the surrounding areas of Scotland. Fully mobile — we come to you at home or work.

Spotless Detailing (trading as Spotless Detailing & Valeting) provides professional mobile vehicle detailing, valeting and paint protection, plus commercial pressure washing and cleaning services, across Glasgow, Uddingston, Bothwell, Bellshill, Hamilton, Motherwell, East Kilbride, Coatbridge, Airdrie, Paisley, Bearsden, Newton Mearns and the wider Greater Glasgow & Lanarkshire area.

## Services

- Safe Wash — from £30, 60–90 min. Swirl-free exterior wash with snow foam, two-bucket method, hydrophobic sealant and dressed tyres.
- Valet — from £60, 2 hours. Full interior and exterior clean: hoovered, surfaces wiped, glass cleaned, exterior safe-washed.
- Deep Clean — from £120, 4 hours. Flagship detail: steam-cleaned interior, shampooed seats and carpets, decontaminated and sealed paint.
- Polishing Package — POA. Multi-stage machine polish and paint correction to restore gloss and clarity.
- Protection Package — POA. Paint correction locked in with a 2, 3 or 5 year ceramic coating.
- Maintenance Plan — bespoke, recurring. Scheduled repeat visits (weekly/fortnightly/monthly) to maintain a car at Deep Clean/Polishing/Protection standard.
- Commercial and residential pressure washing — driveways, patios, render, block paving, and commercial premises (offices, restaurants, golf courses), including scheduled maintenance contracts.
- Fleet washing for businesses, with professional invoices supplied.

All vehicle types are serviced: cars, vans, trucks, caravans, taxis, bikes and quads.

## Key facts

- Based in Glasgow, Scotland, United Kingdom. Fully mobile — the team travels to the customer.
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 8:00–18:00.
- Booking: via the website booking page, contact form, WhatsApp or phone.
- Payment: bank transfer or cash on completion; invoicing available for maintenance plan and business customers.
- Rated 5 stars by customers on Google.
